mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level consistently compresses equity valuations by increasing the risk-free rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the absolute rate level.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate above 206.0 points signals persistent price pressures that erode corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 206.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts above 1500 thousand units and retail sales above 370000 million dollars indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate above 4.5% signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls consistently reflects strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 112.0 points indicates economic contraction, which reduces corporate investment and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 112.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects strong economic expansion that supports corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% and CPI inflation above 206.0 points signals a restrictive monetary policy environment that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL > 206.0.
